topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes

topics.label: Tumor virology, proto-oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the discovery of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and genetic mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional classification and genetic mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressors in cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defective DNA repair and mitotic errors generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how multistep mutation accumulation and inherited genetic predispositions govern tumor development.
